meta.name: gstack-freeze
meta.description: GStack freeze method for pausing writes and limiting work to evidence gathering when a task is unsafe, ambiguous, or production-sensitive.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 暂停写入并限制任务为证据收集，应对不安全或模糊场景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在生产敏感或不确定的任务中安全暂停写入操作
copy.tagline_en: Pause writes and limit tasks to evidence gathering for unsafe or ambiguous scenarios

howto.what: 装上后，当任务不安全、模糊或涉及生产环境时，Claude 会暂停写入操作，只进行只读的证据收集，并给出冻结原因、允许的只读检查、被阻止的操作以及恢复条件。
howto.when: 当用户明确说出“$gstack-freeze”，或任务涉及生产/数据安全、信息不足、需要暂停写入时触发。

say.text: 请执行 $gstack-freeze，这个任务我不确定。
say.note: Claude 会进入冻结模式，只收集信息不写入。

say.text: 先冻结，我需要更多证据再决定。
say.note: Claude 会暂停写入并列出允许的只读操作。

howto.what_en: When a task is unsafe, ambiguous, or production-sensitive, Claude pauses writes and limits work to read-only evidence gathering, producing freeze reason, allowed read-only checks, blocked actions, and resume condition.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly says "$gstack-freeze", or when the task involves production/data safety, insufficient facts, or needs write pause.

say_en.text: Please execute $gstack-freeze, I'm unsure about this task.
say_en.note: Claude enters freeze mode, only gathers evidence.

say_en.text: Freeze first, I need more evidence to decide.
say_en.note: Claude pauses writes and lists allowed read-only checks.
